name: What is the step-by-step process for sealing interior log walls?

mainEntity.name: What is the step-by-step process for sealing interior log walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: The interior sealing process begins with cleaning the log surfaces to remove dust, soot, and grease, followed by light sanding or scraping of any failed, flaking finishes. Once the wood is clean and dry, backer rod is inserted into larger open joints to ensure proper three-point adhesion before applying flexible, textured interior chinking. After the joints and checks are sealed, crew members apply compatible interior wood finishes or topcoats using brushes and sprayers. Preparing surrounding areas—such as taping off trim, covering finished floors, and masking nearby drywall or tile—is crucial to protect indoor living spaces during application.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes cleaning and prepping log surfaces, installing backer rod in deep gaps, applying flexible chinking, and coating the logs with a compatible interior finish.
